lines.en: My claws dig into the ground.
My two hind legs cover a lot of ground.
I move up the river valley.
My tail feathers balance me.

lines.zh: 爪子上的大趾一直抬着
lines.en: My raised sickle toe stays clear of the dirt.
I slip low through the ferns.
I am watching the open ground ahead.
My prints carry claw marks.
I test every step before taking it.
I round a boulder.
My head bobs with each stride.
I climb toward the scent.
I part the grass into a seam.
I halt, then go on.
I stand with my weight forward.
I lift one hind leg.
My claw tip scratches twice.
I tilt my head to listen.
A low note in my throat.
I am reading which way the wind blows.
I narrow my eyes toward the distance.
My tail feathers brush the ground.

lines.zh: 这片河谷没有别的猎手
lines.en: No other hunter in this valley.
I stretch my neck out.

lines.zh: 我的镰爪踩在枯枝上，试了试。
lines.en: I test my sickle claw on a dry branch.
I ruffle the feathers on my back.
I wait for one sound.
I shift my weight foot to foot.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛竖起来，脖颈前伸。
lines.en: My feathers rise and my neck stretches forward.
You are standing in my hunting ground.
My claws have not come down.
You are looking at my feet.
I tilt my head, judging distance.

lines.zh: 我的镰爪抬起来，就是一下。
lines.en: One lift of my sickle claw.
You did not run; that is rare.

lines.zh: 我嘴里发出短促的声音
lines.en: I make a short sound.
Only a few paces of grass between us.
I lift one foot.
You back away, and my head follows.

lines.zh: 这里的风把你味道送过来
lines.en: The wind brings your scent.
I hiss once.
I turn and step back.
A few feathers have been pulled.

lines.zh: 我的一条腿不太吃得住力
lines.en: One leg will not take weight.
That was not shallow.
I growl and reset my stance.
My claws are still trembling.

lines.zh: 我的尾羽扫过土，稳住了身子。
lines.en: My tail feathers sweep the dirt and steady me.
I can lunge one more time.
Do not stand there watching.

lines.zh: 那味道让我喉咙里发出低响。
lines.en: That smell draws a low rumble from my throat.
I tilt my head toward the scent.
I stretch my neck out.
It is still twitching.
I move my claws forward.
Bring it nearer.
Waiting is what I like least.
That will not fill my jaws.
Do not let your hand tremble.
I smell blood.
You struck my ribs.
I turn aside to shed the force.
I am pushed back half a step.
That did not hurt me.
I swing my tail for balance.
That was a solid hit.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上滑了一下
lines.en: My claw slipped on the ground.
Do not press so close to me.
I pull back and drop low again.
Do not touch my hind legs.
I lower my head before you.
My tail feathers open a little.

lines.zh: 我绕着你不紧不慢地走
lines.en: I circle you at an unhurried pace.
This valley is enough for two.

lines.zh: 我用吻部碰了碰你的颈
lines.en: I brush my snout against your neck.
We hold this slope together.
You go ahead; I take the rear.
I make one very soft call.

lines.zh: 风把我们的味道混在一起
lines.en: The wind mixes our scents.
There is no need to hurry now.
I lower my head and take it.
I shake it twice; it holds.

lines.zh: 这东西硌牙，我叼着走了两步。
lines.en: This thing hurts my teeth; I carry it two steps.

lines.zh: 蒙古的驰龙，爪子拨了一下。
lines.en: A Mongolian dromaeosaur nudges it with a claw.
I pin it under a foot.
Heavier than expected, but I carry it.

lines.zh: 我的名字来自阿喀琉斯。
lines.en: My name comes from Achilles.
This is no prey.
I will keep it; it may be useful.
I carry it and look back at you.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖在抖，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your knees are shaking; I see it clearly.
I lower my centre of gravity.

lines.zh: 爪子上的大趾抬了起来
lines.en: My sickle toe has lifted.
You are not retreating fast enough.
It starts with this step.
The wind suits me.
I have your flank in view.

lines.zh: 我抬起镰爪，重心落在后腿。
lines.en: I lift my sickle claw and shift my weight to my hind legs.
I have measured this leap.
I won't give you time to prepare.
I counted one breath.
You chose to stand.
Then let us begin.

lines.zh: 我的爪子不会空着回来
lines.en: My claws will not come back empty.
I track your outline.
You go left; I am ahead of you.
I drop until I am almost flat.
I circle at your flank.
You turn your head too slowly.

lines.zh: 你的后脚跟陷进了松土。
lines.en: Your heel has sunk into the soft soil.
My breathing is even.
The wind takes me downwind of you.
You snapped a dry leaf.
That told me where you are.

lines.zh: 我在草丛里换了个角度，绕到侧面。
lines.en: I shift my angle in the grass and circle to your flank.
You are starting to panic.
This path narrows as it goes.
I press in a little more.
The distance is enough.
The sickle claw falls first.
I leap and bite into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一爪是白垩纪教我的
lines.en: This claw was taught by the Cretaceous.
Your force throws me off.
Blood spatters the feathers on my chest.
I shake my head and tear it open.
My hind legs kick off your body.

lines.zh: 你退了两步,我退了一步
lines.en: You retreat two; I retreat one.
My sickle toe is still extended.
You are guarding your throat.
Then I will look elsewhere.
I land very lightly.
You are still standing; interesting.

lines.zh: 阿喀琉斯之名的驰龙，爪子很快。
lines.en: A dromaeosaur named for Achilles — quick claws.
I step out over fallen leaves.
My claws emerge from the grass first.
My tail feathers fan out.
One sharp call.
I set my sickle toe back down.

lines.zh: 河谷的风从我背后吹来
lines.en: The valley wind comes at my back.
I stand on the slope, looking down.

lines.zh: 蒙古的干风把我的羽毛吹平。
lines.en: Mongolia's dry wind flattens my feathers.
I take a step; the grass flattens.
The birds overhead have fled.
I shake the dust off my back.

lines.zh: 阿喀琉斯之名不是白叫的
lines.en: The name Achilles is not unearned.
The Mongolian wind is dry.
I lower my head to check the ground.
Only then do I raise my eyes to you.
This step, I take very slowly.
So that you hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 我从河谷的芦苇里迈出来，很轻。
lines.en: I step out of the river reeds, very quietly.
My feathers are scorched black.
I crash down onto stone.
Water floods my nostrils.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀进灌木，羽毛焦了。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the bushes, feathers scorched.
An arrow sticks in my thigh.

lines.zh: 那道力量让我的腿发软
lines.en: That force weakens my legs.
Too hungry even to lunge.
Lightning runs through my back.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地,我的爪抓不住
lines.en: No ground; my claws find nothing.
